text:
Stretched out,
+
+stone made of midday,
+
+half-closed eyes where white shades into blue,
+
+a half-open smile.
+
+You rise halfway and shake your lion’s mane.
+
+Then you lie down,
+
+a slender groove of lava in the rock,
+
+a sleeping bolt.
+
+While you sleep I caress and polish you,
+
+slender axe,
+
+arrow with which I set the night on fire.
+
+
+Far off the sea battles with swords and feathers.

translation.title: Stretched Out…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
